content: Is there any library for Hodge star and Riemannian manifold? sorry if this question seems a little naive, I am new

This is not a naive question at all. In general basic questions go in #new members but questions about whether material is present are perfect for this channel. The definition of a Riemannian manifold is in mathlib, you can find it by going to https://www.leanexplore.com/ or https://leandex.projectnumina.ai/ or https://leansearch.net/ and typing "Riemannian manifold". Once you have found the declaration, read the material at the top of the file to understand the content better. Note that it is a relatively new development and there is very little content so far (I have a student working on the construction of a Riemannian structure on the nnn-sphere).

There has been a recent discussion about the Hodge star on this Zulip, you can search for that using the Zulip search box. I just tried that and it sent me here #maths > Hodge star operator @ 💬 .
